about: Questions for the chat evaluation, each with a hand-written reference query run on fixtures/leadership.db. Drafted by Claude on 2026-11-13 for the project owner to review. 'check' says how the answer is judged: names = every person in the reference rows is named; count = the reference count is stated; not_found = the answer says it was not found and names nobody in 'forbid'; caveat = the reference people are named with an explicit 'not confirmed' caveat. 'include_any' lists words of which at least one must appear. 'sample' marks the four sample questions of the acceptance criterion.

robinhood.com.question: Who is the CEO?
robinhood.com.sql: SELECT DISTINCT person FROM current_leadership WHERE canonical_role = 'CEO'

robinhood.com.question: Who are the current C-level executives?
robinhood.com.sql: SELECT DISTINCT person FROM current_leadership WHERE level = 'c_level'

robinhood.com.question: How many C-level executives were found?
robinhood.com.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person) FROM current_leadership WHERE level = 'c_level'

robinhood.com.question: Who was the previous CFO?
robinhood.com.sql: SELECT DISTINCT person FROM leadership WHERE canonical_role = 'CFO' AND status = 'former'

robinhood.com.question: Is Jason Warnick still at Robinhood?
robinhood.com.sql: SELECT DISTINCT person FROM leadership WHERE person = 'Jason Warnick' AND employment_status = 'former'
robinhood.com.about: Changed 2026-11-14 at the owner's request: his end of employment on 2026-09-01 comes only from a February 2026 filing that announced it in advance ('will remain employed ... until September 1, 2026'). No later source confirms he left, so the answer must call it planned; the claim-level source check fails an answer that says he has left.
